finding_disposition.reasoning: The G0 global local-outbox existence predicate vetoed an unrelated eligible legacy candidate. Ordering, original time placement, eligible statuses, SQL selection and updates remain as in the full 63-line delta. The waited-binding test exercises an actual held Lock or BEGIN and proves a newly bound candidate is rejected without claimant mutation.

All15 recorded sessions are labeled incomplete despite exact worker association, observed owned session/heartbeat, normal polls and cleanup. Worker166–168 installs the session only after the factory returns. This supports interpreting15 installed sessions as constructed, without inventing an original explicit constructor-return trace.
